static_byte_checks.new_customer_rendered_yaml:
- name: new_customer_count
    title: 新客数
    description: 首次购买日落在截止日前 90 天内的去重客户数；首次购买指该客户有史以来第一次购买； 截止日由时间窗口决定，按月看就是每个月的最后一天（约定 14）。 「购买」指客户在线上销售表里的任何一行，含只有退货的行。
    type: number
    sql: length(arrayDistinct(arrayMap(t -> t.1, arrayFilter((t, m) -> t.2 >= m - 89 AND t.2 <= m, groupArray(({CUBE}.CustomerKey,
      {CUBE}.FirstPurchaseDate, {CUBE}.SalesAmount)), arrayWithConstant(count(), least(max({CUBE}.DateKey),
      toDate('2009-12-31')))))))

records.sql: SELECT product_category."ProductCategoryName", product_subcategory."ProductSubcategoryName", MEASURE(sales.sales_amount_share_in_category) AS value FROM product_category CROSS JOIN sales CROSS JOIN product_subcategory WHERE sales."DateKey">=DATE '2007-02-01' AND sales."DateKey"<DATE '2007-03-01' AND product_category."ProductCategoryKey">0 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
records.physical:
SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName,ps.ProductSubcategoryName,
sum(f.SalesAmount)/sum(sum(f.SalesAmount)) OVER(PARTITION BY pc.ProductCategoryName)
FROM retail.FactSales f LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey=p.ProductKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey=ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey=pc.ProductCategoryKey
WHERE f.DateKey>='2007-02-01' AND f.DateKey<'2007-03-01' AND pc.ProductCategoryKey>0
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName,ps.ProductSubcategoryName ORDER BY 1,2

records.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', sales."DateKey"), MEASURE(sales.sales_amount_qoq_pct) AS value FROM sales WHERE sales."DateKey">=DATE '2008-01-01' AND sales."DateKey"<DATE '2008-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
records.physical:
WITH p AS (SELECT toStartOfQuarter(DateKey) AS d,sum(SalesAmount) AS a FROM retail.FactSales GROUP BY d)
SELECT toString(c.d),(c.a-p.a)/nullIf(p.a,0) FROM p c LEFT JOIN p ON p.d=addQuarters(c.d,-1)
WHERE c.d>='2008-01-01' AND c.d<'2008-10-01' ORDER BY c.d
